title: 高盛刘劲津：MSCI中国9倍市盈率，估值触底了吗
speaker: Kenja Lao

segments.en: Do you think we've reached a floor when it comes to valuations yet?
segments.zh: 你认为估值已经触底了吗？

segments.en: I would say so. Okay. So if you look at the latest number that we have, well, we look at MSI China as a benchmark.
segments.zh: 我认为是的。以MSCI中国指数为基准，看最新数据。

segments.en: So right now the market is trading on about nine times forward earnings.
segments.zh: 目前市场前瞻市盈率约为9倍。

segments.en: But if you go back to the past two decades of history, essentially we are back to the trough pre September 2024.
segments.zh: 但回顾过去二十年，我们基本回到了2024年9月前的低谷。

segments.en: And obviously in September 2020-04 we had the so-called positive pivot.
segments.zh: 显然，2024年9月我们迎来了所谓的积极转折。

segments.en: So the very important, the other very important moving part here is of course our earnings expectations.
segments.zh: 另一个重要变量当然是盈利预期。

segments.en: And how Chinese equities have been delivering earnings to shareholders.
segments.zh: 以及中国权益资产如何向股东兑现盈利。

segments.en: Now, three years ago, two years ago, the earnings picture was pretty down bit.
segments.zh: 两三年前，盈利状况相当低迷。

segments.en: But now, even with our below consensus expectations on earnings, with expecting earnings to grow about 10% for the overall market.
segments.zh: 但如今，即便我们预期低于市场共识，整体市场盈利预计增长约10%。

segments.en: Are you seeing earnings being, what is the earnings breadth?
segments.zh: 你们看到盈利表现如何？盈利广度怎样？

segments.en: Is it concentrated mainly in the SOE's or are you seeing it broadening out to the rest of the markets?
segments.zh: 是主要集中在国企，还是看到它向其他市场扩散？
